Subject: Handoff: Quality monitoring incubation plan & implementation cadence

Hi Alia / Aurelia team,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. As promised, Im sending a concise incubation plan for the Quality Monitoring (QM) work we'll run during the next six weeks so your engineering and ML ops teams can align. The goal: integrate prompt sets into our eval harness, drive a lightweight regression alerting surface, and run a canary for the first rollout with clear rollback criteria.

High level phased approach (summary):
- Phase 0 (this week): finalize initial prompt set and acceptance criteria. I attached promptset_v1.csv as the starting canonical list.
- Phase 1 (week 1-2): wired eval harness integration (we will run nightly synthetic evals + artifacted metrics). Deliverable: eval_harness_integration.md + baseline metric report.
- Phase 2 (week 3): regression alert tuning (false-positive budget, severity mapping, and alert destinations).
- Phase 3 (week 4): canary rollout to 5% traffic with canary_matrix.xlsx documenting metrics, thresholds, and rollback triggers.

Immediate asks from Aurelia:
1) Confirm the two prompt families in promptset_v1.csv (clinical triage + eligibility) by EOD Friday.
2) Share Slack channel or on-call rotation for PS/ML questions so we can route alerts during canary.
3) Any procurement constraints for us to cross-sign the canary schedule into your change window (procurement@aureliahealth.com is CCd).

Attachments: promptset_v1.csv (preview), eval_harness_integration.md (draft), canary_matrix.xlsx (template).

Ill schedule a 30-minute alignment on Thursday to lock down the narrow acceptance criteria and the integration owner on your side. If Marissa / Monica can own the internal rollout steps and Soojin can be our integration point for the eval harness, that will help speed things up.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Alia — thanks for the clarifications. Quick responses and next steps: 

1) Procurement addendum: we have a short one-page SOW addendum that covers canary schedule and data handling for QM. Ive linked the DocuSign below; if procurement signs this week we can confirm the Saturday window for the first canary (preferred 2026-07-10 02:00-06:00 PDT).
2) Security: Our eval harness runs inside Redwoods private execution environment by default and does not stream or persist raw patient text to third-party SaaS. We produce artifacted metrics (signal counts, embeddings diffs, scalar pass/fail) and persist those in your vaulted project. Monica will send the short security note and dataflow diagram to redact any ambiguity.
3) Canary cadence and rollback: we propose a 5% traffic canary for 24 hours with the following quick rollback triggers (copied from canary_matrix.xlsx):
   - >3% increase in high severity user-facing errors relative to baseline
   - >2x increase in median latency for generation requests
   - Any safety/regulatory violation flagged by the eval harness (auto-rollback)
   - Manual rollback allowed by Aurelia on-call (documented in the change ticket)

Action items assigned:
- Marissa (owner): finalize severity mapping and open the change ticket.
- Monica (security): send the dataflow note and signed security addendum template.
- Soojin (infra): confirm nightly eval runtime and exclude first two runs from alerting.
- Alia / Rahul (Aurelia): confirm eligibility prompts and procurement signature for addendum.
